items.title: MGM Resorts International (MGM) Stock Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: People Incorporated’s cancelled plan to acquire a 73.9% stake in MGM Resorts International (MGM) for US$9.3b in cash has left investors reassessing the stock’s standalone outlook. The cancellation hit short-term sentiment hard, with the share price down 3.3% on the day and the 30-day share price return falling 25.0% to US$32.58.
